name: boot_kernel_rom_start
comment: Start of the boot reflash kernel image copied to RAM 0x3f9800

name: boot_kernel_rom_end
comment: End of the boot reflash kernel image

name: supervisor_qspi_command_bytes
comment: ROM: QSPI command-RAM bytes for supervisor-chip jobs (0x5D = PCS1 chip select) (was j1939_msg_descriptor_table)

name: pci_receive_message_table
comment: 15 J1850 PCI messages the ECM receives (OBD-II 68 6A request / 0x24 / 0x37 shift lever / ...); count at 0x57bab

name: pci_transmit_message_table
comment: 25 J1850 PCI messages the ECM transmits (0x10 engine data / 48 6B OBD-II response / D1 03 / F0 xx VIN / ...); count at 0x57bad

name: pci_receive_message_count
comment: ROM constant 15 (lhz) - entries in pci_receive_message_table

name: pci_transmit_message_count
comment: ROM constant 25 (lhz) - entries in pci_transmit_message_table

name: pci_transmit_message_19_initial_payload
comment: ROM template for the PCI TX[19] header 0xED payload (0x64 0x3B 0x64 0x00 0x00) copied by cm848_initPciMessagePayloads - bytes 4-5 are then overwritten from pci_vehicle_information_byte_4 and vehicle_body_style_code (was unnamed)

name: pci_diagnostic_power_up_announcement
comment: ROM 51 01 01 61 copied after pci_ecm_address into pci_transmit_message_10 at init (length 5 / timer 1): the ECM broadcasts 26 10 51 01 01 61 once at power-up - a reset / alive announcement (0x51 = 0x11 + 0x40); the 0x24 handler rejects a real 0x11 with 7F 11 12 (was DAT_00057bb6) (Medium confidence)

name: pci_security_key_table
comment: 16 ROM words XORed into the seed by each of its 4 nibbles (plus 0x1911) to form the PCI security key: a81f 57c9 4140 ... d507 - identical to the SCI table at flash2 0x53abfe (was DAT_00057bbe)

name: qadc_channel_dispatch_table
comment: 129-entry x 8-byte table: channel index -> (QADC result-reg pointer + shared 0x57dd0); read via base[i*2] by governor_cruise_engage_check + ~38 sensor sites; verified ptrs 0x304a80.. = MPC555 QADC right-justified result regs; double-indirection asm slwi r
column5: 3/lwzx/lhz @0x512ebc

name: boost_pressure_fixed_reference
comment: ROM constant 1132 (61 kPa): subtracted from intake manifold pressure instead of barometric pressure when boost_uses_barometric_pressure_flag is 0 (cm848_calculateBoostPressure / cm848_evaluateProtectionModeFlags) (was oil_pressure_baseline_ref)

name: cruise_switch_sensor_config
comment: Base of the cruise-control switch QADC channel (0x2f/47) config struct; param_1 of cm848_processCruiseSwitchChannel/init; field +2 read as ushort in sensorChannelTypeB_configInit
column5: fields +4/+6 are cruise_engage_adc_valid_upper/lower; ROM-sourced so NO _cal

name: cruise_engage_adc_valid_upper
comment: ROM const =976 (0x3d0); upper open/short validity bound for the analog QADC channel checked by governor_cruise_engage_check (asm lhz 4(r4) @0x512edc); ~95% of 10-bit FS; field +4 of sensor-config struct @0x5ab84; ROM-sourced so NO _cal

name: cruise_engage_adc_valid_lower
comment: ROM const =92 (0x5c); lower open/short validity bound (asm lhz 6(r4) @0x512ed0); ~9% of 10-bit FS; field +6 of sensor-config struct @0x5ab84; ROM-sourced so NO _cal

name: obd_dtc_code_table
comment: ROM table: OBD-II DTC code per fault slot (word per slot) - modes 2 / 3 / 7

name: cruise_speed_low_limit
comment: cruise control low set-limit speed; broadcast as cruise_low_set_limit_speed in PGN 65261 (SPN 88) scaled *161/100/256; gates cruise_control_denied_status=8 when cruise_speed_setpoint_adjusted falls below it. Bank1 ROM/flash constant - NOT EEPROM so no _cal

name: switch_31_on_time_fault_enable
comment: ROM constant 0: nonzero enables the switch 31 on-time fault in cm848_checkSwitch31OnTimeFault (fault bit 73 after 1 s on) and one of its switch copies; 0 in S90140.06 so the fault never sets (was DAT_0005c28c) (Medium confidence)

name: fuel_demand_rate_limit_debounce_low_cal
comment: Debounce count for the fuel-demand rate limiter when fuel_demand_cal_index <= throttle_fuel_demand_adjusted; when the per-mode increment reaches it a protection safety bit latches

name: idle_validation_fault_minimum_vehicle_speed
comment: vehicle_speed must exceed this (2560 = 10 mph) for the idle validation fault debounce (P2121 / P2127 / P2128) to advance while the idle position fuel_demand_cal_index is above fuel_demand_cal_offset + 116 - ROM constant so no _cal (was fuel_demand_smoothing_temp_threshold_cal)

name: fuel_demand_rate_limit_debounce_cal
comment: Default debounce count for the fuel-demand rate limiter; per-mode increment reaching it latches a protection safety bit (safety_bits_1 0x4000/0x8000 or safety_bits_2 0x10)

name: j1939_input_source_priority
comment: ROM constant (0): priority level the J1939 input layer writes switches and inputs at

name: j1939_engine_retarder_selection_default_percent
comment: ROM constant (0): retarder selection used while the J1939 value is missing

name: j1939_engine_fan_requested_speed_default
comment: ROM constant (0): fan request used while the J1939 value is missing

name: etc2_timeout_reload_count
comment: ROM constant 50 - reload count for the ETC2 PGN 61445 receive timeouts - cm848_j1939ProcessPgn61445Etc2 loads etc2_selected_gear_timeout = this+1 - ROM not EEPROM so no _cal (was DAT_0005c39e)

name: accelerator_pedal_press_window_limit
comment: ROM constant 50 = 5 s of 100 ms passes (e2m Throttle_Cycle_Time_Limit - 0.1 s units - time limit for throttle cycles to turn the test switch on): the third accelerator press must come within it after the first (was DAT_0005c66a)

name: accelerator_pedal_press_threshold
comment: ROM constant 280: accelerator position (fuel_demand_control_t.calculated - 400 = 100 percent) that arms a press = 70 percent (e2m Throttle_Diagnostic_Threshold_Upper_Limit) (was DAT_0005c66c)

name: accelerator_pedal_release_threshold
comment: ROM constant 120: accelerator position at or below which an armed press is counted = 30 percent (e2m Throttle_Diagnostic_Threshold_Lower_Limit) (was DAT_0005c66e)

name: pci_message_timeout_grace
comment: ROM constant 50 (lhz) - a PCI message is flagged timed out once its timer exceeds interval by more than this

name: pci_link_error_limit
comment: ROM constant 255 (lhz) - pci_link_error_count value that latches the PCI link failure

name: pci_ecm_address
comment: ROM word 0x0010: the ECM's J1850 node address - first byte of every OBD-II and diagnostic response (cm848_processPciObdRequest / cm848_processPciDiagnosticRequest) (was j1939_dm_node_id_cal)

name: wait_to_start_lamp_fault_set_threshold
comment: ROM byte 5: wait_to_start_lamp_fault_count value that sets fault slot 15 (P0381 wait to start lamp) - about 1 s at ~200 ms passes (was DAT_0005c7b6)

name: wait_to_start_lamp_fault_clear_threshold
comment: ROM byte 0: wait_to_start_lamp_fault_count at or below which fault slot 15 (P0381) is cleared (was DAT_0005c7b7)

name: pci_vehicle_information_byte_4
comment: ROM constant 0x2F (47) sent as PCI TX[19] header 0xED payload byte 4 - only reader cm848_initPciMessagePayloads - meaning unknown (the DRB database decodes only bytes 1 and 5 of 0xED) (was DAT_0005c7b8) (Medium confidence)

name: vehicle_body_style_code
comment: ROM constant 0x13 = 19 = DR (Ram pickup): Chrysler body style code sent as PCI TX[19] header 0xED payload byte 5 (DRB state list Body Style from PCM) - only reader cm848_initPciMessagePayloads (was DAT_0005c7b9) (Medium confidence)

name: obd_mode_1_supported_pids
comment: ROM: mode 1 supported PIDs (bit 31 = PID 1) (was j1939_dm1_spn_support_bitmask)

name: obd_pid_1_monitor_support
comment: ROM: mode 1 PID 1 monitor bytes - high byte low nibble = byte B supported continuous monitors / low byte = byte C (was j1939_dm1_lamp_status_cal)

name: obd_requirements_standard
comment: ROM: mode 1 PID 0x1C value - the OBD requirements this vehicle meets (was j1939_dm1_spn28_value_cal)

name: obd_mode_2_supported_pids
comment: ROM: mode 2 supported PIDs (bit 31 = PID 1) (was j1939_dm2_spn_support_bitmask)

name: obd_mode_9_supported_info_types
comment: ROM: mode 9 supported InfoTypes (bit 31 = InfoType 1) (was j1939_dm9_spn_support_bitmask)

name: obd_mode_9_message_counts
comment: ROM: OBD-II mode 9 message counts - [0] calibration ID messages (InfoType 3) / [1] CVN messages (InfoType 5); only 2 bytes - 0x5c7cc / 0x5c7cd are the PCI 0x2D receive-error thresholds (was j1939_dm9_capability_cal)

name: cluster_lamp_status_error_set_threshold
comment: ROM byte 200: cluster_lamp_status_error_count value that sets fault slot 14 (P1652) - about 40 s of PCI 0x2D receive errors at ~200 ms passes (was obd_mode_9_message_counts+2)

name: cluster_lamp_status_error_clear_threshold
comment: ROM byte 0: cluster_lamp_status_error_count at or below which fault slot 14 (P1652) is cleared (was obd_mode_9_message_counts+3)

name: pci_in_frame_response_wait_limit
comment: ROM constant 3 (lhz) - scheduler passes to wait for the in-frame response to our own TX frame

name: engine_off_time_unchanged_count_limit
comment: ROM 16: consecutive key cycles with an engine-off time within engine_off_time_unchanged_delta of the previous one that set fault word 19 bit 4 (engine-off time stuck - no DTC) (was DAT_0005c7d0) (Medium confidence)

name: engine_off_time_unchanged_delta
comment: ROM 2: a key-on engine-off time that differs from the previous key cycle's value by less than this counts as unchanged in cm848_latchAndCheckEngineOffTime (was DAT_0005c7d1) (Medium confidence)

name: coolant_temperature_check_minimum_engine_off_time
comment: ROM 480 (8 h if minutes): cm848_checkCoolantTemperatureSensorPerformance can fail only when engine_off_time_at_key_on is at least this or the PCI 0x42 time is missing or flagged stuck (fault word 19 bit 4) (was DAT_000642dc) (Medium confidence)

name: USIU_SIMASK
comment: MPC555 USIU SIU interrupt mask register (SIPEND 0x2fc010 / SIMASK 0x2fc014 / SIEL 0x2fc018 / SIVEC 0x2fc01c) - each set bit enables one SIU interrupt vector - used broadly - mpc555_timerInterruptHandler masks it per vector then dispatches (was scheduler_task_enable_flags)

name: USIU_SIEL
comment: MPC555 USIU SIU interrupt edge/level (SIEL) register at 0x2fc018 - sits between USIU_SIMASK 0x2fc014 and USIU_SIVEC 0x2fc01c in the SIU block - cm848_initPciControllerInterface sets bit 0x200 here alongside SIMASK to enable PCI interrupt vector 6 (was scheduler_task_pending_flags)

name: SIU_SGPIODT1
comment: MPC555 SIU general-purpose I/O data register 1 - output lines are driven here (was system_capability_flags)

name: SIU_SGPIODT2
comment: MPC555 SIU general-purpose I/O data register 2 (was calibration_config_word)

name: CMFMCR_A
comment: MPC555 CMF flash module A module configuration register (was mislabeled QADC64)

name: CMFTST_A
comment: MPC555 CMF flash module A test register (was mislabeled QADC64)

name: CMFCTL_A
comment: MPC555 CMF flash module A high-voltage control register (BLOCK / PE / SES / EHV) (was mislabeled QADC64)

name: CMFMCR_B
comment: MPC555 CMF flash module B module configuration register (was mislabeled QADC64)

name: CMFTST_B
comment: MPC555 CMF flash module B test register (was mislabeled QADC64)

name: CMFCTL_B
comment: MPC555 CMF flash module B high-voltage control register (was mislabeled QADC64)

name: flash2_writes_enabled
comment: Nonzero allows diagnostic writes to Bank-2 flash 0x500000-0x5fffff (memory region type 2); otherwise those addresses report 9 = not writable

name: eeprom_service_mode_flags
comment: EEPROM-programming service-mode flags byte. High bit 0x80 = in EEPROM mode; low nibble (& 0xf) gates special main-loop processing; whole-byte 0x81 routes main-loop dispatch to CAN handlers and 0x82 to the diagnostic handler (mpc555_runPeriodicInterruptTimerTick/cm848_runBootKernelLoop/cm848_dispatchDiagnosticService) - name covers the dispatch role not just diag. Renamed from qadc_a_result_high_1 (legacy mislabel - not analog data; real QADC-A results are at 0x304A80+). Peripheral/RAM region 0x302xxx so no _cal

name: qsmcm_portqs_low
comment: PORTQS low byte (port QS pin levels); init 0x7f; bit 0x04 = PQS2/SCK idle level set per slot clock polarity

name: QSMCM_PQSPAR
comment: Port QS pin assignment (init 0x7b)

name: QSMCM_DDRQS
comment: Port QS data direction (init 0x7e)

name: qsmcm_qspi
comment: QSPI control/status registers SPCR0..SPSR (0x305018-0x30501f)

name: qsmcm_tranram
comment: QSPI transmit RAM (was eeprom_command_register)

name: qsmcm_comdram_0
comment: QSPI command RAM entry 0 (was eeprom_timing_reg_0)

name: qsmcm_comdram_1
comment: QSPI command RAM entry 1 (was eeprom_timing_reg_1)

name: qsmcm_comdram_2
comment: QSPI command RAM entry 2 (was eeprom_timing_reg_2)

name: qsmcm_comdram_3
comment: QSPI command RAM entry 3 (was eeprom_timing_reg_3)

name: qsmcm_comdram_4
comment: QSPI command RAM entry 4 (was eeprom_timing_reg_4)

name: qsmcm_comdram_5
comment: QSPI command RAM entry 5 (was eeprom_timing_reg_5)

name: memory_region_table
comment: Boot reflash kernel write-permission map (6 regions) - region 0 = main flash 0x0-0x6ffff type 4

name: sensor_channel0_interp_state
comment: interp current_index for sensor channel 0 config lookup

name: sensor_channel0_filter_config_ptr
comment: config pointer for sensor channel 0 (was DAT)

name: sensor_channel1_interp_state
comment: interp current_index for sensor channel 1 config lookup

name: sensor_channel1_filter_config_ptr
comment: config pointer for sensor channel 1 (was PTR_DAT)

name: sensor_channel16_filter_config_ptr
comment: config pointer for sensor channel 16 (was PTR_DAT)

name: accelerator_pedal_sensor_counts
comment: Copy of accelerator_pedal_sensor_filtered taken by cm848_fuelDemandBaseCalculation; compared with the idle position by cm848_evaluateIdleValidationSwitches (was throttle_fuel_demand_adjusted)

name: j1939_diagnostic_handler_count
comment: entry count of the J1939 diagnostic dispatch table at 0x3fa8b2 - incremented by the registrar cm848_j1939RegisterDiagnosticService and used as the scan bound by cm848_j1939DiagnosticServiceHandler - max 32 - live RAM value 24 (was engine_state_scan_counter)

name: j1939_dm13_network_command_byte
comment: Copy of DM13 data byte 1: 2-bit stop (00) / start (01) / don't care (11) fields - mask 0x30 J1587 / 0x0C J1922 / 0x03 J1939 network 1 (0xC0 current data link is not used) (was j1939_governor_status_byte)

name: j1939_ccvs1_two_speed_axle_byte
comment: CCVS1 transmit byte 1: bits 1-2 two-speed axle switch (SPN 69) from switch 31 - 0xFF when two_speed_axle_enable_cal is 0 (was j1939_dm1_status_byte)

name: j1939_ccvs1_wheel_based_vehicle_speed
comment: CCVS1 transmit bytes 2-3 (low byte first): wheel-based vehicle speed (SPN 84 1/256 km/h) = vehicle_speed x 412/256 clamped at 156 mph - 0xFFFF when drivetrain_type < 1 (was etc1_transmission_ratio_scaled)

name: j1939_ccvs1_cruise_brake_clutch_byte
comment: CCVS1 transmit byte 4: bits 1-2 cruise control active (cruise_control_engaged_flag) / 3-4 cruise control enable switch (switch 31) / 5-6 brake switch (switch 11) / 7-8 clutch switch (switch 15); 3 = not available when the switch is datalink-sourced (was j1939_ccvs1_override_status)

name: j1939_ccvs1_cruise_set_resume_byte
comment: CCVS1 transmit byte 5: set / coast / resume / accelerate switch fields - all derived from switch 31 and j1939_tsc1_active_flag; 0xFF when j1939_governor_feature_cal bit 6 is clear (was j1939_ccvs1_control_byte)

name: j1939_ccvs1_cruise_set_speed_byte
comment: CCVS1 transmit byte 6: cruise control set speed (SPN 86 km/h) = cruise_speed_command x 412 >> 16; 0xFF when j1939_governor_feature_cal bit 6 is clear (was j1939_cruise_speed_byte)

name: j1939_ccvs1_pto_and_cruise_state_byte
comment: CCVS1 transmit byte 7: bits 1-5 PTO governor state (SPN 976) = protection_event_code when j1939_governor_feature_cal bit 4 else 0x1F / bits 6-8 cruise control state (SPN 527) = ccvs1_cruise_control_state (was j1939_ccvs1_event_bits)

name: j1939_ccvs1_idle_switches_byte
comment: CCVS1 transmit byte 8: idle increment / idle decrement / test mode fields derived from switch 31 - shutdown override always not available (was j1939_ccvs1_pto_flags)

name: j1939_dm1_lamp_status
comment: byte 0 of the DM1 (PGN 65226) TX payload = lamp status (MIL/RSL/AWL/PL); set to j1939_buildLampStatusByte() when faults pending else 0; tx_buf_ptr points here

name: j1939_dm1_flash_lamp_status
comment: byte 1 of the DM1 (PGN 65226) TX payload = flash lamp status; initialized to 0xff (not available) in cm848_initPgn65226Dm1Handler

name: j1939_eec2_low_idle_and_kickdown_byte
comment: EEC2 transmit byte 1: bits 1-2 accelerator low idle switch (SPN 558) / bits 3-4 kickdown (pedal above DAT_0005c392 - 2 on safety faults) / bits 5-8 not available (was j1939_status_byte_b)

name: j1939_eflp1_fuel_delivery_pressure
comment: EFL/P1 (PGN 65263) transmit byte 1: fuel delivery pressure (SPN 94 - 4 kPa/bit) from fuel_delivery_pressure_sensor_filtered (was j1939_engine_load_byte)

name: j1939_et1_engine_oil_temperature
comment: ET1 (PGN 65262) transmit bytes 3-4 (low byte first): engine oil temperature (SPN 175 - 0.03125 deg C/bit - offset -273) from oil_temperature_sensor_filtered; 0xFEFE on its fault bits (was j1939_pgn65262_intercooler_temp)

name: governor_speed_error_settled_count
comment: Passes in a row of cm848_processGovernorLoadCondition (governor_fuel_demand_mode 11) with |governor_speed_error_delta| at or below 4000 (500 rpm) - cap 75 / reset above; 75 with vehicle_speed at or above 4 mph and governor_active_flag sets governor_enabled_flag (was fuel_temp_trim_confirm_counter)

name: cruise_switch_request_speed_control
comment: Debounced cruise switch request (ON_OFF / CANCEL / COAST / SET / RESUME / IDLE) - written and read ONLY by cm848_processProtectionControlStateMachine from its own protection_control_state_check_2 sample - selects that governor SET / RESUME / COAST / CANCEL (was governor_speed_request_state) (Medium confidence)

name: accelerator_pedal_press_count_previous
comment: accelerator_pedal_press_count at the end of the previous 100 ms pass; count 1 with previous 0 marks the first press of a window (was protection_retry_active_flag)

name: accelerator_pedal_sensor_fault_hold_flag
comment: 1 = hold switch 31 on: j1939_feature_enable_flags_cal bit 11 set and an accelerator pedal sensor fault active (P2121 / P2122 / P2123 / P2127 / P2128 fault bits or bits 52 / 53) - written by cm848_checkAcceleratorPedalSensorFaults (was protection_mode_enable_flag)

name: accelerator_pedal_pressed_flag
comment: 1 = the accelerator reached accelerator_pedal_press_threshold (280 = 70 percent) and has not yet come back to accelerator_pedal_release_threshold (120 = 30 percent); that return counts one press (was fuel_demand_hysteresis_flag)

name: switch_31_on_time_counter
comment: 20 ms passes switch 31 has been on - counted only while switch_31_on_time_fault_enable (ROM 0x5c28c) is nonzero (0 here); 50 (1 s) sets fault bit 73 (safety_bits_2 bit 9) (was governor_overspeed_protection_enable_flag)

name: load_protection_confirm_a_snapshot
comment: write-only/dead snapshot of governor_status_flags confirm-A bit (0x4000) - set in cm848_updateLoadProtectionArming cleared in cm848_clearLoadProtectionConfirmState never read; was misnamed governor_status_overspeed_flag_snapshot (NOT overspeed)

name: protection_diagnostic_status_intermediate
comment: intermediate protection status = protection_fault_condition_value | confirm-B bit3; zero-tested to pick the derate speed target and OR-folded into protection_diagnostic_status (cm848_calculateDiagnosticStatusBits). NOT a magnitude - was misnamed protection_fault_severity which collided with protection_fault_severity_code @0x408788

name: transmission_vehicle_speed_filter_state
comment: EMA state for transmission_vehicle_speed_filtered: pointer to transmission_vehicle_speed_filter_coefficient (set by cm848_initProtectionSystem) followed by the accumulator (was protection_load_filter_state_a_ptr)

name: transmission_vehicle_speed_filter_accumulator
comment: 16.16 accumulator of the transmission_vehicle_speed_filtered EMA (second word of transmission_vehicle_speed_filter_state) (was protection_load_filter_accum_a)

name: cruise_switch_interp_index
comment: Interpolation cursor for the cruise-switch resistor-ladder lookup (table_interp_args_t.current_index field); param_3 of cm848_process/initCruiseSwitchChannel; written sth r
column5: 0(r5) @0x501be0 (update resets =2) and read/written as args->current_index inside lookupTableInterpolation (0x55ef4). NOT a full table_interp_args_t - lookupTableInterpolation takes the X/Y tables + input value as separate regs r4-r7
column6: only current_index comes from this struct. Working RAM (ROM->RAM window) so no _cal

name: cruise_switch_filter_coeff_ptr
comment: EMA smoothing-coefficient pointer for the cruise-switch ADC filter; param_7 of cm848_process/initCruiseSwitchChannel and param_2[0] of exponentialMovingAverage (0x56594) where *(short*)*ptr is the alpha coefficient; +0 of the channel's 8-byte EMA state. Renamed from PTR_DAT_003fb1f4 (type pointer was already correct)

name: cruise_switch_filter_accum
comment: EMA accumulator (running filtered value in <<16 fixed-point) for the cruise-switch ADC filter; param_2[1] of exponentialMovingAverage
column5: written *(uint*)(state+4) @ sensorChannelTypeB_configInit; +4 of the channel's EMA state. Working RAM (ROM->RAM window) so no _cal

name: intake_manifold_pressure_snapshot
comment: Copy of sensor_readings_t.intake_manifold_pressure (slot 1 absolute manifold pressure - 1/18.56 kPa per count) taken each pass by cm848_processSensorTemperatureData; no reader found (was oil_pressure_reading_snapshot)

name: supervisor_watchdog_question
comment: Current watchdog question (reply low 4 bits) - selects the answer table row (was engine_phase_bits_working)

name: supervisor_qspi_slot
comment: QSPI device slot for the supervisor chip (mode 0 / 2000 kHz) (was injection_sync_broadcast_byte)

name: supervisor_watchdog_start_reply
comment: Watchdog status reply during start-up: question + error count (was engine_phase_and_position_bits_packed)

name: supervisor_watchdog_reply
comment: Watchdog status reply: low 4 bits next question / bits 4-6 error count (was engine_sync_phase_byte)

name: supervisor_output_write_transmit_word
comment: QSPI transmit word of supervisor_output_write_job: 0x9200 | supervisor_register_146_output_value (register 0x92 = output lines 144-151) (was j1939_lamp_status_tx_word)

name: supervisor_watchdog_error_count_previous
comment: Watchdog error count from the previous cycle (was engine_phase_bits_snapshot)

name: serial_output_driver_reply
comment: Raw QSPI reply from the serial output driver (was j1939_periodic_timer_state)

name: serial_output_driver_last_reply_time
comment: Time base (TBL) of the previous serial output driver reply (was j1939_periodic_timer_snapshot)

name: pci_controller_byte_index
comment: Index of the next byte handed to the J1850 controller - shared by frame bytes (cm848_sendPciFrameByte) and in-frame response bytes

name: pci_receive_status
comment: Top 3 bits of the current pci_receive_word (0x20/0x40/0x80 = data byte; 0xa0/0xc0/0xe0 = end of frame); reused by cm848_completePciFrame as the error bits of an unmatched frame

name: pci_receive_word
comment: Copy of pci_controller_receive_word for the current byte: high byte = controller status / low byte = data byte (or completion status on end of frame)

name: pci_controller_command_word
comment: Next command word for the J1850 controller (one byte is a command code e.g. 0xbc / 0xb4 / 0x04 / 0x0c and the other a data byte); copied to pci_controller_transmit_word before queuing

name: pci_qspi_queue_result
comment: Return value of the last cm848_queueQspiJob call for a PCI controller job (-1 = queue full / bad job)

name: pci_in_frame_response_length
comment: Number of in-frame response bytes being sent (length of the matched RX entry in_frame_response_bytes); 0 = not sending

name: pci_controller_init_queue_result
comment: Write-only capture of the cm848_queueQspiJob result for pci_controller_command_job during controller init - written only in cm848_initPciControllerInterface and cm848_continuePciControllerInit - never read - parallels pci_qspi_queue_result (was j1939_queue_tx_return_a)

name: pci_link_error_count
comment: Counts link events whose action mask has bit 0x01; at pci_link_error_limit sets fault_detected_bits_368_to_383 0x8000 and calls mpc555_driveOutputLineLow(124) (output line 124)

name: pci_in_frame_response_wait_count
comment: Scheduler passes spent waiting for the in-frame response to our own TX frame (pci_frame_match_flags 0x08); past pci_in_frame_response_wait_limit -> cm848_handlePciInFrameResponseTimeout

name: pci_diagnostic_parameter_base_address
comment: Address cm848_lookupParameterIdAddress returns for pci_diagnostic_parameter_id (services 0xA1 / 0xA4) (was uds_write_base_address_working - also used by reads)

name: pci_diagnostic_parameter_id
comment: 16-bit parameter ID of a 0xA1 / 0xA4 request = (request byte 3 << 8) | byte 4 - resolved by cm848_lookupParameterIdAddress (the parameter ID table the CLIP memory services also use) (was uds_subfunction_packed_word)

name: pci_diagnostic_address_offset
